lynx_commit_note: stamped by the writer: the newest commit touching this folder when the manifest was written

input.note: procedural, no generated input (plan.md P4: the glass and paper stay procedural; operator pick: props parametric). Reference: art-breakdown.md row 1 (backlit glass table, bright white edge light, emissive frame strip, the glass blue comes from the paper material, not a tint), the Director review of 04fc311 (rim, legs and rails near-black as in lookdev/00-hero.jpg; style-block.json studio #0A0F18 is the only dark value in the block, so it is the dark metal base) and brushed aluminium feet and ledge.

mesh_acceptance.note: re-imported from final.glb: 1 mesh object, 304 vertices, 586 tris, 14 connected components (rim, ledge, strip, glass, apron, legs, feet, rails), 0 floaters (a floater is a component whose bounding box touches no other), 2 open edges (the single-sided glass plane); glass plane faces up: true, 166 x 76 cm at z 0.942 m; glass in its own slot frame_glass_placeholder_REPLACE_IN_UE

scale.note: 180 x 90 x 95 cm (x, y, z up) re-imported from final.glb; top surface z = 0.95 m; edge thickness 3 cm at the outer front edge (target 3.0, the lamp-agent C-clamp grip); pivot: floor centre, x,y centre 0, 0, feet at z = 0 m. Assumption: the 95 cm top is a Lynx choice and the 1.80 x 0.90 m outline the owner's (2026-10-24); the UE world scale of the table (W3.2) is still to be confirmed on Wolf.

finishing.note: one UV set (1); 6 PBR PNGs (dark metal and aluminium: base colour, normal, ORM, 512 px, the largest 372633 bytes), every file under 10 MB (largest 659916 bytes); 4 material slots (frame_dark_metal, frame_aluminium, frame_edge_glow, frame_glass_placeholder_REPLACE_IN_UE); emissive slot frame_edge_glow on 40 faces; evidence framing check passes on 5 images (min silhouette margin 0.0604 of the image, rule 0.03); evidence rendered with Cycles on the CPU. Not claimed: any UE import.

materials: frame_dark_metal (rim, trestle legs and rails: dark metal on the style block studio near-black #0A0F18, metal 0.85, roughness about 0.42, PBR textures)
frame_edge_glow (emissive edge strip #F4FAFF, emission strength 1.5 (glTF emissive_strength), 2 cm wide and 8 mm tall on the whole ledge; UE drives the intensity)
frame_glass_placeholder_REPLACE_IN_UE (placeholder plane, base #BFD8F0, alpha 0.15: UE replaces it with the procedural glass and paper)

bounds_cm.note: x,z ground plane, y up (glTF); length 180, depth 90, height 95

pivot: floor centre (x and y at the middle of the 1.80 x 0.90 m outline, z = 0 at the feet); the table stands +Y in the GLB (glTF Y-up), +Z in Blender
scale_reasoning: Table top surface at 95 cm (wolf-plan W3.2 starts there; R4 lets the owner change it). Outline 1.80 x 0.90 m, a long drafting light table (the owner chose about 180 x 90 cm on 2026-10-24, spark vr-hands-zoom; the first frame was 1.20 x 0.80). The top is 3 cm thick at the outer edge because lamp-agent's manifest says its C-clamp grips a 3 cm table edge; the apron under the top is inset 6 cm so the clamp finds a bare edge. The rim is 5 cm wide; the glass opening is 1.70 x 0.80 m with a 2 cm ledge, and the ledge carries the emissive strip (2 cm wide, 8 mm tall, its top 6 mm under the rim top, so the 45 degree camera sees it), so the glass panel is 1.66 x 0.76 m, recessed 0.8 cm below the rim top. The legs stand 8.5 cm in from the sides and, along the length, 8.5 cm in at 1.20 m and further in as the top grows (15 cm at 1.80 m).
textures: frame_dark_metal_* and frame_aluminium_*: 512 x 512 seamless PNG base colour, normal and ORM (R occlusion, G roughness, B metal), authored with numpy in scripts/art/light-table-frame/build_frame.bpy. Box-projected UVs in world metres, 1 uv unit = 0.4 m, repeating. Flat colour and brushed grain, no baked light. The glow and glass slots are flat colours with no texture.
blender: Blender 5.2.2, scripts/art/light-table-frame/build_frame.bpy (build and score), render_frame.bpy (evidence and framing check), write_manifest.mjs
licence: own procedural work; no generated input, no Leonardo, ComfyUI or TRELLIS

review_fixes.review: Director review of 04fc311 (evidence/turnaround.jpg), 2026-10-21: "the geometry is clean and cheap, but the look departs from the art bible. The table in docs/concepts/vr-light-table/lookdev/00-hero.jpg has a dark, near-black frame with a bright white emissive light strip along the glass edge. The build is warm wood and shows no visible emissive edge." Reworked the same day on the CPU only (Blender, Cycles on the CPU; no ComfyUI, TRELLIS, GPU job or external API).
